primary_question: Can the retrospective 24-hour SEP forecasting interface be reproduced using only predictor values proven available before forecast issue time?
secondary_question: How much predictor coverage and forecast behavior remain after issue-time causal availability is enforced?

phase_b_replay.allowed_population: development-exposed historical outcomes strictly before protected boundary
phase_b_replay.retrospective_condition: archived feature interface and frozen historical prediction where available
phase_b_replay.operational_condition: only predictor values with issue-time availability and schema equivalence evidence

primary_descriptive_metric.name: operationally_reproducible_feature_fraction
primary_descriptive_metric.formula: VERIFIED predictor columns / total audited predictor columns
primary_descriptive_metric.interpretation: interface reproducibility ratio, not a physical constant or new theorem

hypotheses.null: Enforcing issue-time causal availability produces no material reduction in usable interface coverage or replay behavior.
hypotheses.alternative: At least one predictor family is not causally reproducible and enforcing availability materially reduces interface coverage and/or changes replay behavior.
